summary: Approved. All 105 iteration-0 ops applied with no skips or clamps and the render matches the dry run. Sheets 1-3: both feet now sit on the floor line through stance with flat soles (lowest foot z between -0.008 and +0.010 on every frame, 0 penetration frames, shins clear). Stance travel is steady: left contact segment F000-F025 and right F019-F040 move backward with speed std 0.009 and 0.006 against means of 0.030-0.033 (was 0.020-0.021), and whole-body speed stays between 12.5 and 25.9 deg/frame, so the stop at each contact is gone. Lift-off reads: heel peels from F016/F036 with the toe planted, the foot leaves on F004/F024, the knee folds to about 130 and the toe clears by 0.11-0.20. Touch-down is flat on F000/F020 from 0.02 the frame before. The planted foot no longer swivels, the hips shift 0.05 over the stance foot (3/4 view F012 vs F032), and arms, chest and head are staggered (overlap 1.0, no lockstep). Seam: F040 matches F000, no seam or corner metrics. No regressions found. Only low-severity polish remains.

findings.observation: The hands have no keys, so each hand stays locked in line with its forearm through the whole arm swing (3/4 view, all frames). A few degrees of wrist drag would soften the arms. Polish only: hand trails back (+rx) while its arm travels forward and leads on the way back.

The swing foot's height is slightly double-humped: toe clearance peaks at 0.20 on F029-F030 (left) / F009-F010 (right), sags to 0.11 on F034-F035 / F014-F015, then holds 0.12 before it comes down over the last 3 frames (0.12, 0.07, 0.02, 0.00). It never touches the floor and is hard to see at speed; a little more knee fold late in the swing would make it one arc.
